ops.name: bilateral_blur
ops.summary: Edge-preserving blur with live colour and spatial sigmas. The graph unrolls the window, so it is the slowest demo here.

ops.name: blur_pool2d
ops.summary: Anti-aliased downsampling (BlurPool): blur then stride-2 subsample. The output is half size.

ops.name: box_blur
ops.summary: Mean filter over a square window.

ops.name: canny
ops.summary: Canny edge detector. Its threshold check reads tensor values in Python, so it cannot export with live thresholds; the frames were rendered offline along the low threshold.

frames.note: high_threshold is fixed at 0.2 in this demo

ops.name: edge_aware_blur_pool2d
ops.summary: BlurPool that keeps edges above a threshold sharp; the output is half size.

ops.name: fft_conv
ops.summary: The same 2D convolution computed through the FFT.

ops.name: filter2d
ops.summary: Convolution with a 2D kernel; pick one of the predefined kernels.

ops.name: filter2d_separable
ops.summary: Separable convolution: the same 1D kernel along x and y.

ops.name: filter3d
ops.summary: 3D convolution of a volume with a user kernel.

ops.name: gaussian_blur2d
ops.summary: Separable Gaussian filter. The kernel size is fixed per graph; sigma drives the graph live.

ops.name: guided_blur
ops.summary: Guided filter using the image as its own guidance; eps controls the edge preservation.

ops.name: in_range
ops.summary: Mask of the pixels whose every channel lies between two bounds.

ops.name: joint_bilateral_blur
ops.summary: Bilateral blur whose range weights come from a separate guidance image (the fixed reference under the output).

ops.name: laplacian
ops.summary: Laplacian of the image; the output is signed and shown normalised.

ops.name: max_blur_pool2d
ops.summary: Max pooling followed by BlurPool; the output is half size.

ops.name: median_blur
ops.summary: Median over a square window; exports through a sort-based selection.

ops.name: motion_blur
ops.summary: Directional blur along a line kernel; angle and direction are live.

ops.name: motion_blur3d
ops.summary: Motion blur along a 3D direction: a line kernel of the given size, rotated by the angles.

ops.name: sobel
ops.summary: Sobel edge magnitude per channel.

ops.name: unsharp_mask
ops.summary: Sharpening by subtracting a Gaussian blur; sigma is live.

ops.name: apply_colormap
ops.summary: Maps a grayscale image through a colour map.
ops.pre: the sample is converted to grayscale first

ops.name: bgr_to_rgb
ops.summary: Swaps the blue and red channels.

call: bgr_from_rgb(&img, &mut out)?;  // the same channel swap

ops.name: grayscale_to_rgb
ops.summary: Repeats a single channel three times.
ops.pre: the sample is converted to grayscale first

ops.name: linear_rgb_to_rgb
ops.summary: Applies the sRGB gamma curve.

ops.name: rgb_to_bgr
ops.summary: Swaps the red and blue channels.

ops.name: rgb_to_grayscale
ops.summary: Luma-weighted grayscale.

ops.name: rgb_to_hls
ops.summary: RGB to HLS; shown normalised.

ops.name: rgb_to_hsv
ops.summary: RGB to HSV; hue is in radians, so the output is shown normalised.

call: hsv_from_rgb(&img, &mut out)?;  // H, S, V in [0, 255], unlike kornia's radians

ops.name: rgb_to_lab
ops.summary: RGB to CIE Lab; L is in [0, 100] so the output is shown normalised.

ops.name: rgb_to_linear_rgb
ops.summary: Removes the sRGB gamma curve.

ops.name: rgb_to_luv
ops.summary: RGB to CIE Luv; shown normalised.

ops.name: rgb_to_raw
ops.summary: Simulates a Bayer mosaic with the given colour filter array.

ops.name: rgb_to_rgba
ops.summary: Adds a constant alpha channel; only RGB is displayed.

ops.name: rgb_to_xyz
ops.summary: RGB to CIE XYZ.

ops.name: rgb_to_y
ops.summary: The Y (luma) channel of YUV.

ops.name: rgb_to_ycbcr
ops.summary: RGB to YCbCr.

ops.name: rgb_to_yuv
ops.summary: RGB to YUV; U and V are signed, shown normalised.

ops.name: sepia
ops.summary: Sepia tone.

ops.name: add_weighted
ops.summary: Weighted sum of the image and its horizontal mirror.

ops.name: adjust_brightness
ops.summary: Adds a constant to every pixel.

ops.name: adjust_brightness_accumulative
ops.summary: Brightness scaled by the factor, accumulating over repeated calls as in PIL.

ops.name: adjust_contrast
ops.summary: Multiplies every pixel by a factor.

ops.name: adjust_contrast_with_mean_subtraction
ops.summary: Contrast around the image mean, as in PIL.

ops.name: adjust_gamma
ops.summary: Power-law correction with a gain.

ops.name: adjust_hue
ops.summary: Rotates every pixel's hue by the given angle in radians.

ops.name: adjust_log
ops.summary: Logarithmic tone mapping.

ops.name: adjust_saturation
ops.summary: Scales the HSV saturation.

ops.name: adjust_saturation_with_gray_subtraction
ops.summary: Saturation by blending with the grayscale image, as in PIL.

ops.name: adjust_sigmoid
ops.summary: Sigmoid contrast curve with a cutoff and a gain.

ops.name: equalize
ops.summary: Histogram equalisation per channel.

ops.name: equalize3d
ops.summary: Histogram equalisation of a volume.

ops.name: equalize_clahe
ops.summary: Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalisation.

ops.name: integral_image
ops.summary: Summed-area table; shown normalised.

ops.name: invert
ops.summary: Inverts the image.

ops.name: jpeg_codec_differentiable
ops.summary: Differentiable JPEG encode/decode at the given quality.

ops.name: normalize
ops.summary: Subtracts a mean and divides by a standard deviation; shown normalised.

ops.name: normalize_min_max
ops.summary: Stretches each image to [0, 1].

ops.name: posterize
ops.summary: Keeps only the given number of bits per channel.

ops.name: sharpness
ops.summary: Sharpness blend, as in PIL.

ops.name: shift_rgb
ops.summary: Adds a per-channel offset.

ops.name: solarize
ops.summary: Inverts every pixel above the threshold.

ops.name: threshold
ops.summary: Binary threshold; the threshold is live.

ops.name: bottom_hat
ops.summary: Morphological bottom hat with a square structuring element.

ops.name: closing
ops.summary: Morphological closing with a square structuring element.

ops.name: dilation
ops.summary: Morphological dilation with a square structuring element.

ops.name: erosion
ops.summary: Morphological erosion with a square structuring element.

ops.name: gradient
ops.summary: Morphological gradient with a square structuring element.

ops.name: opening
ops.summary: Morphological opening with a square structuring element.

ops.name: top_hat
ops.summary: Morphological top hat with a square structuring element.

ops.name: affine
ops.reason: needs a transformation matrix or point set as input

ops.name: affine3d
ops.summary: Applies a 3×4 affine matrix to a volume; the page bakes a rotation about the centre with a scale.
ops.snippet: kornia.geometry.transform.affine3d({img}, matrix)  # matrix: (1, 3, 4), e.g. a rotation of {yaw}° about z scaled by {scale}, built with kornia.geometry.conversions

ops.name: center_crop
ops.summary: Crops a centred square of the given side.

ops.name: center_crop3d
ops.summary: Crops the central block of a volume.

ops.name: crop_and_resize3d
ops.summary: Crops a box out of a volume and resizes it to a given size.
ops.snippet: kornia.geometry.transform.crop_and_resize3d({img}, box, ({size}, {size}, {size}))  # box: (1, 8, 3) corners of the region, here voxels 4 to 27

ops.name: crop_by_boxes3d
ops.summary: Crops a volume to a box given by its eight corners; the page bakes a centred box.
ops.snippet: kornia.geometry.transform.crop_by_boxes3d({img}, src_box, dst_box)  # (1, 8, 3) corners each: a centred {size}³ box to a {size}³ output

ops.name: crop_by_indices
ops.summary: Crops a square window given by its corner coordinates; the corner is live, the window size is fixed per graph.

ops.name: elastic_transform2d
ops.summary: Elastic deformation driven by smoothed random noise sampled inside the graph.

ops.name: hflip
ops.summary: Horizontal flip.

ops.name: pyrdown
ops.summary: Gaussian blur then 2x downsample.

ops.name: pyrup
ops.summary: 2x upsample then Gaussian blur.

ops.name: remap
ops.reason: needs a transformation matrix or point set as input

ops.name: rescale
ops.summary: Rescales the image by a factor.

ops.name: resize
ops.summary: Resizes the image to a square of the given side.

ops.name: rot180
ops.summary: Rotation by 180 degrees.

ops.name: rotate
ops.summary: Rotation about the image centre with bilinear sampling; the angle is live.

call: let (w, h) = (img.size().width as f32, img.size().height as f32);

ops.name: rotate3d
ops.summary: Rotates a volume about its centre by yaw, pitch and roll in degrees.

ops.name: scale
ops.summary: Isotropic scale about the centre.

call: let (w, h) = (img.size().width as f32, img.size().height as f32);

ops.name: shear
ops.summary: Shear along x and y.

ops.name: translate
ops.summary: Translation in pixels.

ops.name: vflip
ops.summary: Vertical flip.

ops.name: warp_affine3d
ops.summary: Warps a volume with a 3×4 affine matrix into a given output size; the page bakes a rotation about the centre.
ops.snippet: kornia.geometry.transform.warp_affine3d({img}, matrix, (32, 32, 32))  # matrix: (1, 3, 4), a rotation of {pitch}° about y

ops.name: warp_perspective3d
ops.summary: Warps a volume with a 4×4 homography; the page bakes a shift along x.
ops.snippet: kornia.geometry.transform.warp_perspective3d({img}, H, (32, 32, 32))  # H: (1, 4, 4), here the identity with a translation of {shift} voxels along x

ops.name: CenterCrop
ops.summary: Centre crop to a fixed square.

ops.name: CenterCrop3D
ops.summary: Centre crop of a volume (needs a linear solver, so this shows frames).

frames.note: the crop solves a linear system that does not export

ops.name: ColorJiggle
ops.summary: Random brightness, contrast, saturation and hue in one go, applied in a fixed order.

ops.name: ColorJitter
ops.summary: Like ColorJiggle but the four adjustments are applied in a random order, which cannot be traced.

ops.name: Denormalize
ops.summary: Undoes a mean/std normalisation; shown normalised.

ops.name: LongestMaxSize
ops.summary: Rescales so the longer side equals max_size.

ops.name: Normalize
ops.summary: Mean/std normalisation; shown normalised.

ops.name: PadTo
ops.summary: Pads to a fixed size.

ops.name: PatchMix
ops.reason: needs labels or a batch of several images

ops.name: RandomAffine
ops.summary: Random rotation, translation, scale and shear.

ops.name: RandomAffine3D
ops.summary: Random rotation, translation and scale of a volume.

ops.name: RandomAutoContrast
ops.summary: Stretches each channel to full range (no randomness besides p).

ops.name: RandomBoxBlur
ops.summary: Box blur with a fixed kernel.

ops.name: RandomBrightness
ops.summary: Random brightness factor in [1-s, 1+s].

ops.name: RandomChannelDropout
ops.summary: Zeroes random channels.

ops.name: RandomChannelShuffle
ops.summary: Permutes the colour channels.

ops.name: RandomContrast
ops.summary: Random contrast factor in [1-s, 1+s].

ops.name: RandomCrop
ops.summary: Random square crop.

ops.name: RandomCrop3D
ops.summary: Random crop of a volume (the crop is read in Python, so this shows frames).

frames.note: the crop position is read in Python at run time

ops.name: RandomCutMixV2
ops.reason: needs labels or a batch of several images

ops.name: RandomDepthicalFlip3D
ops.summary: Flips the volume along depth.

ops.name: RandomElasticTransform
ops.summary: Elastic deformation with random displacement noise.

ops.name: RandomEqualize
ops.summary: Histogram equalisation.

ops.name: RandomEqualize3D
ops.summary: Histogram equalisation of a volume with probability p.

ops.name: RandomErasing
ops.summary: Erases a random rectangle.

ops.name: RandomFisheye
ops.summary: Random fisheye distortion.

ops.name: RandomGamma
ops.summary: Random gamma in [1-s, 1+s] with a random gain.

ops.name: RandomGaussianBlur
ops.summary: Gaussian blur with a random sigma.

ops.name: RandomGaussianIllumination
ops.summary: Adds a random Gaussian light spot.

ops.name: RandomGaussianNoise
ops.summary: Adds Gaussian noise.

ops.name: RandomGrayscale
ops.summary: Converts to grayscale with probability p.

ops.name: RandomHorizontalFlip
ops.summary: Horizontal flip with probability p.

ops.name: RandomHorizontalFlip3D
ops.summary: Flips the volume horizontally.

ops.name: RandomHue
ops.summary: Random hue shift in [-h, h].

ops.name: RandomInvert
ops.summary: Inverts with probability p.

ops.name: RandomJigsaw
ops.summary: Shuffles the tiles of a grid (the permutation is applied in Python, so this shows frames).

ops.name: RandomLinearCornerIllumination
ops.summary: Linear light gradient from a random corner.

ops.name: RandomLinearIllumination
ops.summary: Linear light gradient in a random direction.

ops.name: RandomMedianBlur
ops.summary: Median blur with a fixed kernel.

ops.name: RandomMixUpV2
ops.reason: needs labels or a batch of several images

ops.name: RandomMosaic
ops.reason: needs labels or a batch of several images

ops.name: RandomMotionBlur
ops.summary: Motion blur with a random angle and direction.

ops.name: RandomMotionBlur3D
ops.summary: Motion blur with a random 3D direction (the kernel is built at run time, so this shows frames).

frames.note: the kernel is built at run time from the drawn angles

ops.name: RandomPerspective
ops.summary: Random perspective warp.

ops.name: RandomPerspective3D
ops.summary: Random perspective warp of a volume (needs a linear solver, so this shows frames).

frames.note: the warp solves a linear system that does not export

ops.name: RandomPlanckianJitter
ops.summary: Colour temperature jitter along the Planckian locus.

ops.name: RandomPlasmaBrightness
ops.summary: Brightness modulated by a plasma fractal.

ops.name: RandomPlasmaContrast
ops.summary: Contrast modulated by a plasma fractal.

ops.name: RandomPlasmaShadow
ops.summary: Shadows shaped by a plasma fractal.

ops.name: RandomPosterize
ops.summary: Posterisation to a random number of bits.

ops.name: RandomRGBShift
ops.summary: Random per-channel shift.

ops.name: RandomRain
ops.summary: Draws random rain streaks (the drop count is read in Python, so this shows frames).

ops.name: RandomResizedCrop
ops.summary: Random crop of random scale, resized to a square.

ops.name: RandomRotation
ops.summary: Random rotation within +/- degrees.

ops.name: RandomRotation3D
ops.summary: Random rotation of a volume within +/- degrees about each axis.

ops.name: RandomRotation90
ops.summary: Random multiple of 90 degrees.

ops.name: RandomSaltAndPepperNoise
ops.summary: Salt and pepper noise.

ops.name: RandomSaturation
ops.summary: Random saturation factor in [1-s, 1+s].

ops.name: RandomSharpness
ops.summary: Random sharpness.

ops.name: RandomShear
ops.summary: Random shear.

ops.name: RandomSnow
ops.summary: Snow effect.

ops.name: RandomSolarize
ops.summary: Random solarisation threshold and addition.

ops.name: RandomThinPlateSpline
ops.summary: Random thin-plate-spline warp (needs a linear solver, so this shows frames).

ops.name: RandomTranslate
ops.summary: Random translation as a fraction of the size.

ops.name: RandomVerticalFlip
ops.summary: Vertical flip with probability p.

ops.name: RandomVerticalFlip3D
ops.summary: Flips the volume vertically.

ops.name: Resize
ops.summary: Resizes to a fixed square.

ops.name: SmallestMaxSize
ops.summary: Rescales so the shorter side equals max_size.
